essence: Complaint and nearness: Great-One's men levelled, trailers tasting, husband ending death, wink-won All (vv1-4).

Vision's catalogue: moon-drop, sun-spark, third-eye badge, seen joys, city in-making, uneven eyes, might-less being, stayed mind, roaming selves, company-ripened, slave-borne, hunger past-past, ghee-joined pains (vv5-16).
Paradox and seal: fit unreality-show, breathed strands, I-less world, dissolving great, dark range, nectar-nature, speech-jewel, effortless ripening, slave's drink, devouring fire (vv17-26).

sections.SUMMARY: It breaks non-separation by showing it was never sameness: devotees and worldlings share one world but eat differently (1–4); cosmic lights shrink to droplets (5–6); seeing runs both directions at once (7); the pleased drag the world inside (8); all looks same-eyed but for the Uneven-eyed Seer (9); deniers depend on Him (10); the whole path conditional on standing (11); same wandering, different placement (12); mere conduct perfects (13); servants claim bearing (14); vision leaves touch hungry (15); ghee makes sorrows bearable (16); unreality permitted by omnipotence (17); qualities dance, breathed by Him (18); ego the prop of manifestation (19); anger-fire purifies (20); daylight accuses (21); all nectar, yet sole mortality-house (22); name-and-bow-mark empower (23); ease-by-identity demanded (24); slave-and-self, gods sated through him (25); eater-fire between heart and navel closes (26).

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of discrimination (viveka); the vyabhicāri is wonder (camatkāra) at the pairs that refuse to merge. The rasa is the tranquility of non-dual recognition that survives difference — not the thrill of sorting but the peace of seeing all as one while holding difference. Abhinava's rasa theory frames this as śānta: the relish (camatkāra) of the Absolute breaking continuity without breaking oneness.
